verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents an official MCP server as part of its self-hosted Docker deployment, and its GitHub README advertises MCP integration for connecting directly to AI tools like Claude Code, which covers the story's core. Community posts confirm people use it with Cursor and Claude, though new developers reportedly struggle with the configuration. missing for 10: documented MCP tool list and transport/setup details in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of the official server (community guides are third-party), evidence of use without self-hosting the Docker server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP integration for direct connection to AI tools like Claude Code
